title: fadebox catalog index
description: index.yaml at the root of a catalog: browsing metadata for every entry. Fadebox reads exactly this on sync and refuses the whole catalog when it is malformed; unknown properties are ignored so a catalog written for a later fadebox still parses.

apiVersion.description: The one format version fadebox reads. Anything else refuses the catalog whole rather than half-understood.

name.description: Human label for the catalog, shown beside its entries.

slug.description: Stable identifier. Templates imported from the entry record it as provenance; renaming it orphans every copy, which then stops reporting updates.

name.description: Display name, shown on the catalog card.

version.description: The only update signal: a new commit with an unchanged version is not an update. Bump it whenever template.yaml changes.

description.description: One sentence for the card. State any throwaway credentials the entry ships with.

tags.description: Free-form facets for filtering, e.g. database, messaging, auth.

requires.description: Slugs of entries this one expects at their well-known service names — what the import dialog hints at pairing.

path.description: Path of the entry's template.yaml, relative to the catalog root.
